{{Attr|Stun}} |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Frost Summon}}''' - The '''Frost Necromancer''' will hold its staff into the air, which will spawn four [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]]s from the ground. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Necromancer''' was a high-health summoner [[Enemies|enemy]] that appeared exclusively in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] as part of the [[Frost Invasion Event]]. Currently, it can only appear in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, though it copies the [[Operation I.C.E Event]] [[Frost Necromancer]] statistics, while also having its ability not work. Compared to the [[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)|Frost Hero]], which debuted on the same wave in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]], it had lower health and the same speed. However, the '''Frost Necromancer''' could have posed a threat due to its significantly higher health than most enemies that came before it, along with its ability to summon four [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]]s. ==Appearance== The '''Frost Necromancer''' has black reflective skin, and black granite legs and torso. It wears a black granite textured cloak, complete with a hood and cape. On its shoulders are skull pauldrons. Black chains run along its torso, arms and shoulders. Its torso and leg are cut open and exposed, and its left leg is slightly carved in around its knees. Its arms are also slightly carved in around the elbows. The '''Frost Necromancer''' wears blue metal-plated wristbands. On its torso is a neon blue crystal. It is faceless and also wears a blue face covering, which covers the bottom half of its face. The '''Frost Necromancer''' wields a blue crystal staff to summon [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]]s. This staff emits white particles while its torso emitted light blue smoke. Its head is tilted slightly downwards. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Outpost 32]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]], are recommended to take down the '''Frost Necromancer''' due to its high health. **You should use the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'' ability to boost the firerate of these towers. **You can use the [[DJ Booth]] to increase the range of your towers to prevent this enemy from going out of range of your defenses. ***This also aides in ensuring that any [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]]s that spawn cannot get out of range of your towers. *As with all enemies in the [[Frost Invasion Event]], the [[Pyromancer]] deals double fire damage to the '''Frost Necromancer''' (though normal damage is not doubled). *While the [[Snow Minion (Frost Invasion)|Snow Minion]]s that spawn should not be a huge issue at this stage of the game, you can use towers that hit multiple enemies such as the [[Mortar]] or [[Pursuit]] to easily defeat these. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFrostNecromancer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} FrostNecrodeadcer0.gif|Current death animation (8 May 2021 — Present). FrostSpawnermancer.gif|Current ''Frost Summon'' animation (8 May 2021 — Present). {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} FrostInvasionFrostNecromancerIconIG.png|'''Frost Necromancer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Frost Necromancer''' added. *'''4 December 2021''' - [[v1.0.0]] **'''Frost Necromancer''' removed. *'''20 December 2024''' - [[v1.47.0]] **'''Frost Necromancer''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Frost Necromancer]]'s [[Logbooks|Logbook]] from the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. **{{Bug}} No longer summons anything. {{FrostInvasion|[[Frost Ravager (Frost Invasion)|Frost Ravager]]|Wave 16|Frost Necromancer, [[Crying Angel (Frost Invasion)|Crying Angel]] & [[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)|Frost Hero]]|Wave 19|[[Frost Spirit (Frost Invasion)|Frost Spirit]]|Wave 20}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Frost Necromancer}}
